name: Aryan Circle
description: The Aryan Circle is a white supremacist, neo-Nazi prison gang operating throughout U.S. correctional facilities. It was founded in 1985 by Mark 'Cowboy' Gaspard in the Texas Department of Corrections as a splinter group of the Aryan Brotherhood of Texas (ABT), after the ABT shifted focus away from overt criminal activity toward religion. The Aryan Circle is the second-largest white supremacist prison gang in Texas, with an estimated 1,400 members nationwide across state prisons, federal prisons, out-of-state facilities, and street-level membership. Members engage in drug trafficking, murder, extortion, assault, and contraband smuggling both inside and outside of prisons.
